note: Each observation names the commit GitHub evaluated. A record can carry this file only in a later commit than the one it describes, so the delivered head's own run is read back through the API and through `gh pr checks 5 --required` rather than asserted here. Top-level capturedAt/localHead/remoteHead/requiredChecksOutput preserve the earlier synchronized local snapshot; later API-only observations are appended with their own exact head and timestamps, without asserting a newly sampled localHead.
